description.ar:
ماتت بسبب الأمير وهذه هي عودتها الرابعة.
 لا أستطيع أن أموت مرة أخرى.
 الامير...
 سأغويه.
 "اخبرني مره اخرى. ما تحدثنا عنه في ذلك الوقت ".
 نظر كاستيان الملطخ بالدماء إلى إيرنديل وقال ،
 "أنا معجب بك أنا جاد. قلت ذلك ، أليس كذلك؟ " أدرك إيرنديل أخيرًا.
 
 "إذا أنقذت حياتك ، أخبريني أنك ستكونين معي لبقية حياتك."
 لقد تم تحريف هذا الشيء.

description.en:
I died because of the prince, and it’s my fourth return. I can’t die again. The prince… Let’s seduce him!

“Tell me again. What we talked about back then.”

The blood stained Castian looked at Earendel and said, “I like you. I’m serious. You said that, didn’t you?”

Earendel finally realized…

“So if I save your life, tell me you’ll be with me for the rest of your life.”

…that something has been twisted.

description.fr:
C'était un jour de printemps chaud et ensoleillé, mais différent de d'habitude. (Il y a un jour comme ça, Erendel.) Ma mère me l'a dit une fois. Mais elle est morte il y a plus de dix ans. [C'est un jour curieux où je fais des choses que je ne fais pas d'habitude. Il faut être très prudent un tel jour. [Pourquoi?] Ce jour-là, les yeux violets de ma mère brillaient faiblement au soleil. Elle a jeté un regard froid à la question de sa fille. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ [ Si tu fais une erreur, tu peux être ensorcelée. ] Elle a dit quelque chose que je n'ai pas pu comprendre. [ Être fasciné est pour un moment, mais être ensorcelé est pour toute une vie. ] ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Erendel était assis sur le sol et regardait l'homme avec des yeux vides. Son visage couvert de sang ne lui était pas familier. Non, peut-être qu'elle ne sait vraiment pas. Peut-être que je suis en train de rêver. Mais comme pour m'informer que c'était un espoir sans espoir. Une voix grave a appelé mon nom. "...Erendel." "Redis-moi. Ce dont nous avons parlé à l'époque." Sur les yeux violets clairs d'Erendel se reflétait le Kin ...trempé de sang du Prince Castian. "Je vous aime bien." [ J'aime beaucoup le Prince Castia. C'est aussi beaucoup. ] "Je le pense" [ Je suis sérieux ] "...vous avez dit ça, n'est-ce pas?" "Ou tu m'as menti? Le sourire de Castian était vide. "Je suis en train de me faire avoir." Puis il reprit "Alors dis-moi que je dois te sauver la vie. Puis dis-moi que tu seras à mes côtés." "Vous êtes venu me voir parce que vous vouliez vivre de toute façon, n'est-ce pas?" Il argumente. ...Je veux dire, je ne savais vraiment pas. Que mon ami, que je prenais pour un fou, était le Prince Castian qui m'avait tué tant de fois. savent aussi ce qui va se passer à cause des mots choisis.

description.en: Born in the age of the Japanese civil wars, "Hyakkimaru" had his body stolen from him by demons. He hunts for the demons who have fragments of his body and recovers his body bit by bit. Having lived till the present day chasing after demons in the city's shadows, Hyakkimaru is one day sought out by a child—Roro, a girl who holds a fragment of Hyakkimaru's body despite not being a demon. Under a contract with her, Hyakkimaru goes on his final hunt for the remaining demons...this time, for the sake of becoming a complete human being.

biography.en:
Osamu Tezuka (手塚 治虫, b. 手塚 治, Tezuka Osamu; 3 November 1928 – 9 February 1989) was a Japanese manga artist, cartoonist, and animator. Born in Osaka Prefecture, his prolific output, pioneering techniques, and innovative redefinitions of genres earned him such titles as "the Father of Manga" (マンガの父, Manga no Chichi), "the Godfather of Manga" (マンガの教父, Manga no Kyōfu) and "the God of Manga" (マンガの神様, Manga no Kami-sama). 

Tezuka began what was known as the manga revolution in Japan with his [New Treasure Island](https://mangadex.org/title/63487511-434d-4a98-a1da-13bf80e9fcb8/new-treasure-island-1947) published in 1947. His output would spawn some of the most influential, successful, and well-received manga series including the children mangas [Astro Boy](https://mangadex.org/title/ca4c84bb-7272-45aa-a22d-dc1282b52372/tetsuwan-atom), [Princess Knight](https://mangadex.org/title/eb1b4f6f-8bc2-40a5-9398-768f5d4aea01/princess-knight-1953) and [Kimba the White Lion](https://mangadex.org/title/bad33763-70c6-40b7-8d14-190556fc55f0/jungle-emperor), and the adult-oriented series [Black Jack](https://mangadex.org/title/fd86eab2-f0f3-47d3-bce5-5628e97f37dc/black-jack), [Phoenix](https://mangadex.org/title/cc647d62-3a2c-474b-ac4e-844256ab185d/hi-no-tori), and [Buddha](https://mangadex.org/title/4e102d46-0a98-4249-8a42-98e4705b663e/buddha), all of which won several awards.

Tezuka died of stomach cancer in 1989. His death had an immediate impact on the Japanese public and other cartoonists. A museum was constructed in Takarazuka dedicated to his memory and life works, and Tezuka received many posthumous awards.

The son of the world's top assassin organization leader, Doyul, has transferred to a Korean high school!

Coming in with nothing, Doyul takes on a request from Dong-gu, a victim of school bullying, and begins taking down the local delinquents one by one?!

The story of a man who rises to become the strongest in the War Against Bullies universe!

Lee Shi Yoon is a pianist of the 21st century. 

After getting into an accident that left him unable to play the piano, he becomes resentful of his life and chooses death, only to wake up as the daughter of a rich family that uses an unfamiliar language, named "Tatiana".

 Is this an opportunity given by a god? Or is this a curse? 

Who cares if I switched genders! 

As long as my hands are fine, I can play the piano! Since things have come to this, I'll pursue the dreams I couldn't have through "Tatiana"!

---
After giving up everything and going against his parents' wishes to pursue his dream of becoming a concert pianist, Lee Siyoon is met with a crippling end to his short-lived career when a car accident leaves his right hand immobile. Finding no reason left to live, he attempts to end his meaningless life. But, instead of meeting his maker, he awakens in the company of a large group of Russian servants. Thrown into this new life as Russian heiress, Tatiana Yuryevna Belchenova, there is one thing that's still familiar, the piano. Unable to give up his dream, Siyoon decides to embrace being Tatiana and attends the most prestigious classical music school in Russia. But, with Tatiana's body refusing to cooperate with Siyoon's mind, will he manage to make it to the top this time? To make matters worse, he's surrounded by some surprisingly tough competition and they're all still just teenagers! Confronted with Tatiana's dark secrets, family and classmates who despised the old Tatiana, and teenage boys who are overly interested in the new one, Siyoon has a long road ahead of him.

21세의 피아니스트 이시윤.
사고로 인해 피아노를 더 이상 칠 수 없게 된 삶을 비관하다 죽음을 택했지만,
알아들을 수 없는 외국어로 얘기하는 갑부 집안에서 소녀 '타티아나'로 눈을 뜬다.

​신이 주신 기회인 걸까? 아니면 저주인 걸까?
성별이 바뀐 게 뭐 대수냐! 손만 멀쩡하다면 다시 피아노를 칠 수 있어!

description.zh:
钢琴王子遭遇意外离世！
再睁眼已成异国少女？！
21岁的天才钢琴家李时允，因遭遇事故无法再弹琴，他绝望地选择了离开这个世界。但当再次醒来时，他发现自己身处在一个说着外语的豪宅中，还魂穿到一个名为蒂雅娜的少女身上。这究竟是神赐予的机会还是命中注定？“事已至此，那就让蒂雅娜来实现我未完成的梦想吧！”

description.en: My boyfriend is getting married. To my own sister, no less. I could handle the breakup. Betrayal was nothing new. But accepting the fact that once again my sister stole what was mine proved to be unbearable. In the midst of this heart-wrenching time, I encountered Yunhwan…
description.ko:
“여민아. 나 결혼해.”

남자 친구가 결혼한다. 그것도 내 동생과.
이별은 받아들일 수 있었다. 배신도 익숙했다.
하지만, 또다시 동생에게 내 것을 빼앗겼다는 사실은 받아들이기 힘들었다.
그렇게 가장 비참하던 때, 윤환을 마주쳤다.
태주 그룹 회장의 손주이자 내가 근무하는 연구개발팀의 팀장.

그리고 내 남자 친구였던 김승재의 친척이자 천적.
분한 마음에서인지, 복수를 위해서인지…

나는 그에게 결혼을 제안했다.

“팀장님. 저랑 결혼하실래요?”

description.en:
Ensnared in a dark ploy by both her stepmother and half-sister, Eris was forced to marry the useless and pathetic Gellert. Her married life was rife with difficulties, yet she endured the insults and agony to raise her beloved son, Luka.

But when her husband’s carelessness led to Luka’s death, Gellert tried to comfort Eris by saying, “We’re still young. We can have more children.”

Devastated by his words, Eris prayed to the heavens, begging to have her son back. Moved by her plight, the Golden Dragon manifested his powers to bring Eris back to the day when this all started. Eris was determined to have her revenge against her stepmother, her half-sister, and her ex-husband, but…

“Do the rumors about us upset you?”

Theodore Lehinal, a Duke whom Eris had never even spoken to in her last life, seemed to have taken a sudden interest in her…
description.fr: Eris, piégée par sa sœur, est obligée d’épouser un homme qu’elle n’aime pas. Le seul rayon de soleil de sa vie est Louka, son fils. Mais un jour, alors que son mari batifole avec une servante au lieu de le surveiller, Louka tombe dans les escaliers et meurt… Rongée par la douleur, Eris part alors à la recherche du dragon doré et le supplie de ramener son fils à la vie. Celui-ci acceptera, à condition qu’elle retourne dans le passé pour y rencontrer le fils du dragon. Eris saura-t-elle profiter de cette seconde chance et retrouvera-t-elle enfin son fils bien-aimé?
description.id: Terjebak dalam rencana jahat oleh ibu tiri dan saudara tirinya, Eris terpaksa menikahi Gellert yang tidak berguna dan menyedihkan. Kehidupan pernikahannya penuh dengan kesulitan, tetapi dia menanggung penghinaan dan penderitaan untuk membesarkan putra kesayangannya, Luka. Namun ketika kecerobohan suaminya menyebabkan kematian Luka, Gellert mencoba menghibur Eris dengan mengatakan, "Kita masih muda. Kita bisa punya lebih banyak anak." Hancur oleh kata-katanya, Eris berdoa ke surga, memohon agar putranya kembali. Tergerak oleh keadaannya, Naga Emas menunjukkan kekuatannya untuk membawa Eris kembali ke hari ketika semua ini dimulai. Eris bertekad untuk membalas dendam terhadap ibu tirinya, saudara tirinya, dan mantan suaminya, tetapi... "Apakah rumor tentang kami membuatmu kesal?" Teodore Lehinal, seorang Adipati yang bahkan tidak pernah diajak bicara Eris dalam kehidupan terakhirnya, tampaknya tiba-tiba tertarik padanya...
description.ja:
継母とその娘の罠にはめられ、ろくでもない男・ゲラートと結婚させられたエリス。
結婚生活は不幸そのものだが、愛する一人息子・ルカのために頑張る日々を過ごしていた。

しかし、夫の不注意でルカが階段から落ちて死んでしまう。
「大丈夫。私たちは若いから、子供はまたいくらでも産めるさ」

夫の言葉に絶望したエリスは、神様にルカを取り戻せるならなんでもすると祈る。

すると、その祈りに心が動かされた黄金竜の力により、全てが始まった日に戻された。
エリスは継母、妹、夫、関わったすべての者に復讐を決心する。しかし──

「私が恋人と噂されるのは嫌ですか？」

前世では話したこともない公爵、テオドール・レヒナールになぜか気に入られてしまい?!
description.ko:
백작가의 장녀 에리스 프레이저. 
그녀는 새어머니의 계략에 빠져 태중혼약을 동생에게 빼앗기고, 
변변찮은 남자와 강제로 결혼하고 말았다. 

그럼에도 사랑하는 아이를 낙으로 삼고, 
어떻게든 인생을 꾸려나가 보려고 했건만…. 
바람 난 남편의 부주의 때문에 아들마저 잃고 말았다. 

‘제 아이를 돌려주세요!’ 

에리스는 절망 끝에 백일 밤낮을 기도한 결과, 
과거 혼약을 빼앗기던 순간으로의 회귀에 성공하는데…. 

“따로 사랑하는 사람이 있어?” 

“아니요.” 

“그렇다면 사람들이 넘겨짚는 이야기 속에서 
나의 가짜 연인 역으로 등장하는 게 불쾌할 거 같다든가?” 

“아니요!” 

“그럼 아무 문제도 없는 거로군. 테오라고 불러 봐.” 

흉흉한 소문만이 가득한 흑막 공작에게 계약 결혼 제안을 받았다?
description.pl: Córka wicehrabiego, Eris Fraser. Wpadła w intrygę swojej macochy, straciła kontakt z bratem i ostatecznie przymusowo poślubiła uciążliwego mężczyznę. Mimo to pocieszała się ukochanym dzieckiem i starała się jak najlepiej wykorzystać swoje życie. Jednak z powodu nieostrożnego męża utraciła je. „Proszę, zwróć mi moje dziecko!". W rozpaczy, po codziennej modlitwie przez sto dni, Eris udaje się powrócić do momentu, w którym jej zaręczyny zostały odwołane. „Jest ktoś, kogo kochasz?”- „Nie.”- „Więc czy nie byłoby dla mnie niewygodne, gdybym mógł być twoim fałszywym kochankiem do plotek ludzi?”- „Nie!”- „W takim razie postanowione. Mów mi Theo.” Czy otrzymała propozycję małżeństwa od złowieszczego księcia pełnego złych plotek?
description.pt-br: Enredada numa trama sombria arquitetada por sua madrasta e meia-irmã, Eris foi forçada a se casar com o inútil e patético Gellert. Sua vida de casada foi repleta de dificuldades, mas ela suportou os insultos e a agonia para criar seu amado filho, Luka. Mas quando a negligência do marido levou à morte de Luka, Gellert tentou consolar Eris dizendo: “Ainda somos jovens. Podemos ter mais filhos.” Devastada por suas palavras, Eris rezou aos céus, implorando para ter seu filho de volta. Comovido com seu sofrimento, o Dragão Dourado manifestou seus poderes para trazer Eris de volta ao dia em que tudo começou. Eris estava determinada a se vingar de sua madrasta, sua meia-irmã e seu ex-marido, mas… “Os rumores sobre nós te incomodam?” Teodore Lehinal, um duque com quem Eris nunca havia sequer conversado em sua vida passada, pareceu ter demonstrado um interesse repentino por ela…

description.en:
When Princess Bellia Piolette is ordered by her father to marry Kastor's cruel crown prince who's known for killing his wives, she flees in the night. On the way, Bellia encounters a dying man named Khan and heals him before she's caught and imprisoned in the palace. There, she's miraculously reunited with Khan, who asks her to run away with him. But their time together is cut short when Bellia's forcibly sent to Kastor, where she discovers that her beloved Khan is not who she thought he was...

---
Bella, the woman who saved the dying beast. At that time, she didn't know that he would change her life like this…

Khan, a man who contacted Bella, who was about to leave the country and run away. Unlike her untamed energy, her movements were sweet. His whisper that he will change her shabby life was also sweet. 

"Let me heal you." 

"Follow me." 

If you take one more step, you can hold his hand... Misunderstandings accumulate before even holding his hand. Meeting again, he was no longer an animal, but an emperor. 

"Are you going to be the crown prince?" 

"Khan, I just..." 

His question that I dare not answer. And... 

"That night. You shouldn't have saved me. You should have let me die." 

It had been a long time since the appearance of a relentlessly sweet man to repay his kindness had disappeared.

description.ru: В мире, состоящем из двенадцати фракций племени богов, которые находятся в постоянном противостоянии, представитель группировки собирателей Ларте пал их жертвой, однако был чудесным образом спасён великим героем Тасире. По его словам, Ларте — существо, которое рождается раз в тысячу лет для борьбы с хищниками, и именно ему суждено стать лидером «племени богов». После обучения у Тасире юноша готов отомстить своим врагам за все причинённые страдания, даже если ему понадобится для этого перевернуть весь мир с ног на голову.

Liệu Latde có thể giải phóng thế giới khỏi ách thống trị của ác thú, hay chỉ là "ếch ngồi đáy giếng", không tự lượng sức mình? Số phận của họ vẫn còn là một ẩn số.

Upon opening her eyes, she realizes that she has woken up inside her favorite novel.

description.en:
A child who lost everything to a villain. 
Ten years later, that child returned as a hero called a demigod. 

And the enraged hero began his revenge by killing the villain and his family… 

But there was a problem. 

It was that Lila was the daughter of that villain. 

“Are you Lila Hildegar?” 
“You’ve got the wrong person.”
“No, I think I’ve got the right one.” 

…Pretending to be someone else, failed! 

“Please spare me.”
“No.” 

…Begging for her life also failed! 

There was no other choice.
Lila chose the last resort. 

“Any last words?” 

It was to swallow the “Regression Stone” and return to the past after death. 

“It wasn’t pleasant meeting you, so let’s never see each other again!”

That’s how Lila returned to the past, opened her eyes at the age of ten, and… 

Died again. 

Lila tried to survive. 
She tried and tried again.
That was all she did… 

“Why did you save me?”

The boy answered with a pale face.

“Because I’ve gone mad.” 

…The enemy who had driven Lila to death several times became strange.

To make matters worse, Irwyne's fate in the story is grim as she's condemned to execution for attempting to poison Pervin, the male lead and a highly respected duke. Desperate to survive, Irwyne is determined to win Pervin's heart. But as she grows closer to him, his feelings evolve in unexpected ways. Irwyne now faces an uncertain fate that wasn't written in the novel's pages. Will she be able to rewrite her destiny?

description.en:
Due to an unidentified virus, which has affected the world, many people have turned into man-eating monsters and the screams of dying people have been swallowed by the cries of monsters.

'Kim Jongdo,' a boy who lived a grim life because he didn't receive the attention of those around him due to his inherent lack of presence, survived the apocalypse because he didn't receive attention from the monsters either, and for some reason, Kim Jongdo was also able to speak with some monsters.

While soothing loneliness by communicating with the monsters, he meets a girl 'Jo Myeong' who was in the same class as him during high school by chance.

Unlike the indifference around him, she was one of the few people who treated Kim Jongdo with interest, and that's how Kim Jongdo's "no presence" began to shake.
description.pt-br: Devido a um vírus de origem desconhecida, muitas pessoas se transformaram em monstros terríveis, e os gritos das pessoas foram engolidos pelo choro dos monstros. Kim Jongdo, que viveu uma vida sombria devido à sua falta inata de senso de existência, sobreviveu ao fim do mundo sem receber atenção mesmo dos monstros. Estranhamente, Kim Jongdo conseguiu conversar com alguns monstros. Enquanto encontrava um pouco de conforto na comunicação com os monstros, ele conheceu por acaso uma colega de escola chamada Jo Myeong. Diferentemente da indiferença que recebia, ela foi uma das poucas pessoas que demonstrou interesse genuíno por Kim Jongdo, e assim sua 'falta de existência' começou a ser abalada.

description.en: An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the hidden mastermind ruler… Who will win?
description.ko:
"실패하면 소멸, 성공하면 자유...?"
과로로 죽은 개발자 '나'. 눈을 뜨니 게임에 빙의해있었다.  
게임 안에서라도 모든 것을 잊고 유유자적한 삶을 살기로 결심하자마자, 죽음이 걸린 히든 미션이 떨어졌다.

결국 미션 달성을 위해 스릴 넘치는 고군분투가 이어지...려고 했으나 문제가 있었다.
빙의한 게임이... 미완성으로 방치한 지 오래 된 개발자 '나'의 흑역사 프로젝트였던 것..!

description.en:
"Why do I keep crossing paths with you…? ♡"  
  
Everyone experiences those feelings at least once.  
Sometimes it feels like you're getting smaller in front of someone you like.  
The problem is, I'm actually getting smaller!

Inheriting the divine mission of assisting reincarnators, regressors, and transmigrators, Laura is the sole counselor at the Reincarnation Counseling Center.

But for some reason, the customers—meant to appear once every hundred years—haven’t shown up in five centuries.

After 500 years of waiting, Laura is ready to abandon the center for good when suddenly...

Her long-awaited customer appears.

Or rather, customers.

“...Possession, I think.”
“Regression.”
“Looks more like reincarnation.”
“...Has the world gone mad?”

Why are there three clients all at once?!

With 24 hours a day no longer enough, will Laura be able to handle this chaotic counseling session?

description.en:
'I didn't know then. The fact that these things my father left behind, will devour my destiny.'

With his instant memory recall ability, Jin Yong-woon is attacked by an unidentified assailant, but he manages to avoid the crisis thanks to a mysterious artifact and travels back in time to the Three Kingdoms era.

Using the abilities he obtained from playing the game "Three Kingdoms Special," which he usually enjoys, he faces the Three Kingdoms period and embarks on a new journey with the escort of Zhao Yun and the Four Heavenly Maidens.

description.en:
Seven enlistments. Infinite service. Zero discharge. 

Kim Jae-hwan, a lowly private, has been trapped in a never-ending military time loop, forced to relive his conscription over and over again. No matter what he does, he always ends up back at square one — Private, Day 1. 

The only clue to breaking the cycle? A mysterious line in his military diary: "It was truly the perfect military life." 

Now, in his 7th round of enlistment, Jae-hwan is ready to do whatever it takes— follow every order, befriend every superior, survive every absurdity— to finally write those cursed words… and escape. 

But in a place where logic is warped and sanity is optional, can one soldier truly find the perfect military life?

title.en: Only the Red Panda Daughter-in-Law Receives Loves

description.en:
One day, the fairy of books appeared and told Letty that she was a dying extra character.

“Father-in-law!”
“?”
“Father-in-law, please give me your son!!”

Letty came to marry in place of the female lead to survive, but the in-laws are unbearable!

“I don’t want to work. I’ll take a day off today.”
“If you take today off, it’ll be your 194th day off, Your Grace. It’s already mid-June.”

Her father-in-law, who’s supposed to be the head of the family, is incredibly lazy and is about to ruin the family,

Crash! Bang!
“Why are you breaking things again, husband?”
“I don’t know. I just feel like breaking something every time I see your face.”

The successor, her husband, is the head of the division...!

‘Ugh, I just wanted to heal him and escape, but this isn’t going to work.’

Sigh. There’s no helping it. Until the female lead shows up, should I try helping out this hopeless family a bit?

“Father-in-law, at this rate, you’ll ruin the family!! I’m so embarrassed, I could die!!!”

And so, Letty managed to get the lazy father-in-law to start thinking like a hardworking ant,

“Hubby, your heart is racing again? Don’t break things and hold Letty’s hand.”
Crash! Bang!
“Ahhh~ The young master is destroying the mansion again!”

The attempt to reform her husband failed.

Park Sang-woo is a thoracic surgery chief who has lived without regard for means and methods for success. However, his life is turned upside down in an instant due to an unexpected accident.

Unexpectedly, he returns to his rookie intern days and gains a special ability to see the remaining lifespan of patients. 

Using this ability, he tries to start the path of a true doctor that he had turned away from in his second life.

description.en:
A year after her lover stabs her in the back, legendary assassin Kyla Angel wakes up in the body of Rachel Brown, a nanny tasked with caring for a neglected prince and princess. 

Knowing the man who betrayed her is still out there, Kyla must bide her time before she can sneak out of the palace and get revenge. But in the meantime, she must face her deadliest challenge yet: childcare. 

Now it's up to Kyla to figure out how to soothe a crying toddler with hands meant for throwing daggers and slitting throats...
